name: Special-Ops Neural Executioner (EfficientNet)
description: The heaviest, most devastating war machine in modern forensics. Abandoning manual edge-counts or discrete quantization tracking, the EfficientNet bloodhound is an apex-predator AI exclusively engineered and bred on millions of Deepfake/Synthesis artifacts. Its sole biological imperative is to slaughter other Generation AIs. No matter how flawless Midjourney/SORA hallucinate an image to be, this monster sniffs out the 'electronic blood'—synthetic latent patterns entirely invisible to the naked human eye.
algorithm: Hyper-Architected Convolutional Extraction (EfficientNet Latent Deep Features)
mechanism: This forensic leviathan refuses to count simple pixels like archaic 20th-century scanners. It sadistically devours 100% of the visual canvas, hurling it violently through a hyper-dense Weights Matrix of 100+ 2D Convolutional layers. Generative 'Latent Space' structural failures or denoising fingerprints left foolishly behind by GANs and Diffusion immediately trigger catastrophic alarms deep within EfficientNet’s routing. It spits out a cold, terminal execution sentence based on raw classification probability.
parameters: Neural Core: EfficientNet-B4/B0 Custom Pre-trained Weights, Extraction Architecture: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Trajectory: Deep Latent Spaces
accuracy: Annihilation (92-99%) - The undisputed, unrivaled sovereign of hunting GANs and prime Diffusion. Its presence statistically drives facial deepfake survival rates to near absolute zero.
source: Tan & Le (2019) Google Research AI - Convolutional Model Scaling Redefined
useCase: Throw any suspicious image directly into its jaws. Within milliseconds, this neural brute vomits the ultimate, indisputable verdict: PHYSICAL CAMERA ORGANIC ORIGIN, or SYNTHETIC HALLUCINATION WASTELAND. Zero room for debate.

references.title: Tan, M., & Le, Q. (2019). EfficientNet: Rethinking model scaling for CNNs. ICML.

strengths:
• Bestows apocalyptic accuracy specifically against Human Deepfakes, Midjourney, and Stable Diffusion landscapes due to Google Research's mastercrafted scaling of convolutional weights.
• Massively resilient against evasion attacks (Blur, Resize, JPEG, Noise Injection)... EfficientNet hunts deeply embedded Latent Convolutional signatures, completely disregarding superficial outer camouflage.
limitations:
• An astronomically greedy leviathan that aggressively strip-mines system RAM and GPU VRAM. Pure CPU executions drag out exponentially longer than archaic, lightweight DCT or Edge scripts.
• Vulnerable to the 'New Blood' immunity syndrome: Possesses unmatched neural intelligence, but if explicitly thrown against a hyper-new zero-day AI model (e.g. specialized FLUX iterations) not present in its massive training diet... the executioner's ax may harmlessly bounce off.
